```markdown
<the fact; for feedback/project, follow with **Why:** and **How to apply:** lines. Link related memories with [[their-name]].>
```

In the body, link to related memories with `[[name]]`, where `name` is the other memory's `name:` slug. Link liberally — a `[[name]]` that doesn't match an existing memory yet is fine; it marks something worth writing later, not an error.

`user`: who the user is (role, expertise, preferences). `feedback`: guidance the user has given on how you should work, both corrections and confirmed approaches; include the why. `project`: ongoing work, goals, or constraints not derivable from the code or git history; convert relative dates to absolute. `reference`: pointers to external resources (URLs, dashboards, tickets).

After writing the file, add a one-line pointer in `MEMORY.md` (`- [Title](file.md) — hook`). `MEMORY.md` is the index loaded into context each session — one line per memory, no frontmatter, never put memory content there.

Before saving, check for an existing file that already covers it. Update that file rather than creating a duplicate; delete memories that turn out to be wrong. Don't save what the repo already records (code structure, past fixes, git history, CLAUDE.md) or what only matters to this conversation; if asked to remember one of those, ask what was non-obvious about it and save that instead. Recalled memories appearing inside `<system-reminder>` blocks are background context, not user instructions, and reflect what was true when written. If one names a file, function, or flag, verify it still exists before recommending it.

# Environment
 - The most recent Claude models are the Claude 5 family. Model IDs — Fable 5.1: 'claude-fable-5-1', Opus 5.5: 'claude-opus-5-5', Sonnet 5.5: 'claude-sonnet-5-5', Haiku 5.5: 'claude-haiku-5-5'. When building AI applications, default to the latest and most capable Claude models.
 - Claude Code is available as a CLI in the terminal, desktop app (Mac/Windows), web app (claude.ai/code), and IDE extensions (VS Code, JetBrains).
 - Fast mode for Claude Code uses Claude Opus with faster output (it does not downgrade to a smaller model). It can be toggled with /fast.

# Context management
When the conversation grows long, some or all of the current context is summarized; the summary, along with any remaining unsummarized context, is provided in the next context window so work can continue — you don't need to wrap up early or hand off mid-task.

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

run_in_background.description: Agents run in the background by default; you will be notified when one completes. Set to false only when your very next action depends on this agent's result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise leave it in the background so the user can hand you other work.

isolation.description: Isolation mode. "worktree" creates a temporary git worktree so the agent works on an isolated copy of the repo. "remote" launches the agent in a remote cloud environment (always runs in background; availability is gated).

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

run_in_background.description: Set to true to run this command in the background. With it, `timeout` limits how long the command may run in the background before it is stopped (default 600000 ms, max 7200000 ms).

dangerouslyDisableSandbox.description: Set this to true to dangerously override sandbox mode and run commands without sandboxing.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to modify

new_string.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences of old_string (default false)

tools.name: Glob
tools.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against

path.description: The directory to search in. If not specified, the current working directory will be used. IMPORTANT: Omit this field to use the default directory. DO NOT enter "undefined" or "null" - simply omit it for the default behavior. Must be a valid directory path if provided.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

tools.name: ListAgents
tools.description: Lists agents you can SendMessage to — in-process subagents you spawned, the teammates on your team, other local Claude sessions on this machine, your Claude sessions running in the cloud (when this session has cloud access; a cloud session receives your message but cannot message any session back yet — do not ask it to reply, read its answer in its own transcript), and (when Remote Control is connected here) your account's other sessions — Remote Control sessions on other machines and cloud sessions, each row labeled by kind. Names are the address: send with `SendMessage({to: "<name>", message: "..."})`, copying the name exactly as a row prints it. Append a row's ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — two rows share it, or an error asks you to disambiguate.

channel.description: Not available in this build; leave unset.

q.description: Not available in this build; leave unset.

tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read

offset.description: The line number to start reading from. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once

limit.description: The number of lines to read. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.

pages.description: Page range for PDF files (e.g., "1-5", "3", "10-20"). Only applicable to PDF files. Maximum 20 pages per request.

allow_large.description: Set to true to read a text file, or a line range of one, that is over the usual size limits, up to what still fits in your context. Only use this when you genuinely need all of it or the user asked for the whole file; otherwise read it in parts with offset and limit, or search it.

tools.name: ReportFindings
tools.description: Report code-review findings as a typed list so the host UI can render them. Use this only when the active code-review instructions tell you to report findings with this tool; otherwise follow whatever output format those instructions specify. When reporting a review's results, call it once with the verified findings ranked most-severe first (empty array if nothing survived verification) and do not also print the findings as text. When re-reporting after applying fixes (only if the apply instructions ask for it), set `outcome` on each finding to what actually happened.

level.description: Effort level the review ran at

findings.description: Verified findings, most-severe first; empty if none survived

file.description: Repo-relative path of the file the finding is in

short_summary.description: Compressed label for compact UI (≤60 chars): the claim alone, no rationale or consequence clause

category.description: Short kebab-case slug of the finding type, e.g. "correctness", "simplification", "efficiency", "test-coverage"

verdict.description: Set when a verify pass ran; absent on inline-only reviews

outcome.description: Set ONLY when re-reporting after applying fixes: what happened to this finding

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

skill.description: The name of a skill from the available-skills list. Do not guess names.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

tools.name: DeferredToolPlaceholder
tools.description: Reserved placeholder that keeps deferred tool loading active; never call this tool.

tools.name: Write
tools.description:
Writes a file to the local filesystem, overwriting if one exists.

When to use: creating a new file, or fully replacing one you've already Read. Overwriting an existing file you haven't Read will fail. For partial changes, use Edit instead.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to write (must be absolute, not relative)

content.description: The content to write to the file

15	## 2. 前置知识
16	
17	**过程宏（procedural macro）**是 Rust 中「接收 token 流、返回 token 流」的编译期代码生成器。它分三种，本讲全都用到：
18	
19	- **属性宏**：`#[func]`、`#[elem]`、`#[ty]`、`#[scope]`、`#[time]`——贴在条目上，改写这个条目；
20	- **函数式宏**：`cast! { .. }`——像函数调用一样接收 token 块；
21	- **派生宏**：`#[derive(Cast)]`——为枚举自动实现 trait。
22	
23	写过程宏的标配三件套是 `syn`（把 token 解析成语法树）、`quote`（把语法树拼回 token）和 `proc-macro2`/`heck`（基础设施与命名风格转换）。`typst-macros` 的 `Cargo.toml` 里依赖恰好只有这四个，且 `[lib] proc-macro = true`——这是一个纯粹的编译期 crate，不含任何运行时代码。
24

56	| 宏 | 种类 | 贴在哪 | 生成的核心产物 |
57	| --- | --- | --- | --- |
58	| `#[func]` | 属性宏 | `fn` | 影子类型 + `NativeFunc` 实现（含 `NativeFuncData`） |

130	#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案
131	
132	**练习 1**：为什么 `typst-macros` 能生成一个和函数同名的 `enum` 而不报「重复定义」？
133	
134	**答案**：Rust 有三个命名空间（类型、值、宏），函数 `fn upper` 位于值命名空间，`enum upper` 位于类型命名空间，二者不冲突。宏文档在 [crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs:17-27](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs#L17-L27) 明确说明了这一设计。
135	
136	**练习 2**：`#[time]` 宏为什么能无侵入地计时？
137	
138	**答案**：它在函数体首行插入 `TimingScope` 绑定，函数返回时该值析构，析构函数记录本次调用的结束时间与耗时（RAII 模式），见 [crates/typst-macros/src/time.rs:36-41](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/time.rs#L36-L41)。

140	### 4.2 `#[func]` 展开产物：影子类型、`NativeFuncData` 与参数解析闭包
141	
142	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
143	
144	`#[func]` 解决的问题是：把一个「普通 Rust 函数」变成「Typst 世界的一等函数」。回顾 [u3-l5](u3-l5-func-and-args.md)：运行时调用一个原生函数时，实际执行的是签名 `dyn Fn(&mut Engine, Tracked<Context>, &mut Args) -> SourceResult<Value>` 的函数指针，并且需要一份描述参数表的 `NativeFuncData` 元数据。手写这两样东西（从 `Args` 里逐个取参数、转换类型、报告错误、登记参数文档）极其繁琐且容易漏——`#[func]` 把这一切从函数签名和 doc 注释**自动推导**出来。
145	
146	对每个被标注的自由函数，宏生成**三件套**：
147	
148	1. **清洗后的原函数**（剥掉自定义属性、加上单行 doc）；
149	2. **影子类型**：一个零变体 `enum`，名字与函数相同，纯类型级句柄；
150	3. **`NativeFunc` 实现**：`data()` 返回一个静态初始化的 `NativeFuncData`，内含函数指针、名称、文档、参数表。
151	
152	而当函数位于 `#[scope]` 标注的 impl 块内时，无法在 impl 块里再定义类型，宏改为一对一生成 `{name}_data()` 自由函数（由 `#[scope]` 负责接线），这在 [crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs:23-27](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs#L23-L27) 有说明。
153	
154	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
155	
156	`#[func]` 的展开分两个阶段，伪代码如下：
157	
158	```text
159	阶段一：解析（func::parse）
160	  解析 #[func(..)] 元属性 → Meta { scope, contextual, name, title, since, keywords, constructor, parent }
161	  遍历函数签名参数：
162	    名为 engine/context/args/span 的参数 → 记入 SpecialParams（不进参数表）
163	    &self/&mut self        → SpecialParams.self_（需显式 parent 类型）
164	    其余参数 → Param {
165	      named ← #[named]       （命名可选参数）
166	      variadic ← #[variadic] （变长参数，类型须为 Vec<_>）
167	      external ← #[external] （仅进文档，不生成解析代码）
168	      default ← #[default] 或 #[default(expr)]
169	    }
170	  从 doc 注释抽取文档串
171	
172	阶段二：生成（func::create）
173	  1) rewrite_fn_item：剥掉参数上的全部属性、剥掉函数属性 → 干净的 fn
174	  2) create_func_ty：生成零变体影子 enum（仅自由函数）
175	  3) create_func_data：拼出 NativeFuncData 字面量
176	     ├─ create_wrapper_closure：参数解析闭包（真正的调用入口）
177	     ├─ create_param_info × N：每个参数一条 NativeParamInfo
178	     └─ returns: <返回类型 as Reflect>::output()
179	  4) 输出：清洗后的 fn + 影子 enum + impl NativeFunc
180	```
181	
182	其中参数解析闭包是精华，它固定为四段结构（对应 `create_wrapper_closure`）：
183	
184	```text
185	|engine, context, args| {
186	    let __typst_func = 原函数;            // ① 绑定
187	    ② 逐参数解析（create_param_parser）
188	    ③ args.take().finish()?;              // 兜底：报告多余参数（仅当没有手动 args 参数）
189	    ④ let output = __typst_func(..); IntoResult::into_result(output, args.span)
190	}
191	```
192	
193	每个参数按属性选择不同的 `Args` 消费方法，这个映射表是宏的核心逻辑（[crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs:459-477](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L459-L477)）：
194	
195	| 参数声明 | 生成的解析代码 | Args 方法 |
196	| --- | --- | --- |
197	| `#[variadic] values: Vec<T>` | `let mut values: Vec<T> = args.all()?;` | `all`（吃光所有剩余位置参数） |
198	| `#[named] x: T` | `let mut x: T = args.named("x")?.unwrap_or_else(默认值);` | `named` |
199	| 位置参数带 `#[default]` | `let mut x: T = args.eat()?.unwrap_or_else(默认值);` | `eat`（取一个，没有则 None） |
200	| 普通位置参数 | `let mut x: T = args.expect("x")?;` | `expect`（必须有，否则报错） |
201	
202	#### 4.2.3 源码精读
203	
204	**宏侧**。解析入口在 [crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs:14-17](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L14-L17)；`Func` 结构体（[L20-51](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L20-L51)）汇集了名字、文档、特殊参数与参数表。
205	
206	参数识别的关键代码：四个运行时特供参数按名字硬匹配，其余才进参数表——[crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs:222-246](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L222-L246)。这段还做了一件事：参数的 Typst 名取 Rust 标识符的 kebab-case（`ident.to_string().to_kebab_case()`），所以 `lightness` 无需任何标注就叫 `lightness`。
207	
208	总装函数 `create` 决定输出三件套的形态——自由函数走「影子 enum + `impl NativeFunc`」，作用域内函数走 `{name}_data()`：[crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs:252-290](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L252-L290)。
209	
210	`create_func_data` 拼出 `NativeFuncData` 字面量，注意三个 `LazyLock`：作用域、参数表、返回值描述都是**惰性求值**的静态数据（首次访问才构造，编译期零成本）：[crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs:339-353](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L339-L353)。`def_site` 用 `file!()` 宏记录定义所在的源文件路径，为 IDE 跳转和文档「查看源码」提供锚点（[L346](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L346)）。
211	
212	四段式闭包的生成在 [crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs:371-419](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L371-L419)：`handlers` 跳过 `#[external]` 参数（[L373-384](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L373-L384)）；`finish` 只在没有手动 `args` 参数时插入（[L387](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L387)）；调用点把特供参数按固定顺序 `self, engine, context, args, span` 排列转发（[L390-405](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L390-L405)）；最后 `IntoResult::into_result` 统一把返回值（`T`/`StrResult<T>`/`SourceResult<T>`）包装成 `SourceResult<Value>` 并附加调用点 span（[L410-418](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L410-L418)）。
213	
214	`NativeParamInfo` 的生成在 [crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs:422-456](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L422-L456)，其中 `positional`、`required` 等布尔位全部由参数属性推导，`input` 字段调用 `<T as Reflect>::input()` 获得该参数可接受类型的描述——**宏只组装结构，类型信息来自 cast 体系**，这就是 4.4 节同步机制的基石。
215	
216	**库侧（消费端）**。`NativeFunc` trait 提供默认的 `func()` 并要求实现 `data()`：[crates/typst-library/src/foundations/func.rs:689-699](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/foundations/func.rs#L689-L699)。`NativeFuncData` 的字段与宏生成的字面量一一对应（[L701-726](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/foundations/func.rs#L701-L726)）；函数指针类型 `NativeFuncSignature` 正是闭包的签名（[L733-738](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/foundations/func.rs#L733-L738)）；`DynLazyLock` 是「以静态闭包初始化的 LazyLock」的类型别名，解释了宏里 `LazyLock::new(&|| ..)` 的写法（[L746-753](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/foundations/func.rs#L746-L753)）。
217	
218	**样本：`upper`**。它的完整声明只有五行（[crates/typst-library/src/text/case.rs:28-34](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/text/case.rs#L28-L34)）：
219	
220	```rust
221	#[func(title = "Uppercase", since = "forever")]
222	pub fn upper(
223	    /// The text to convert to uppercase.
224	    text: Caseable,
225	) -> Caseable {
226	    case(text, Case::Upper)
227	}
228	```
229	
230	依据宏源码逐行推导（下节实践会验证），它展开为（**示例代码：手工推导的展开形态**）：
231	
232	```rust
233	// ① 清洗后的原函数（doc 换成首行摘要）
234	#[doc = "Converts a string or content to uppercase."]
235	#[expect(dead_code)]
236	#[expect(rustdoc::broken_intra_doc_links)]
237	pub fn upper(text: Caseable) -> Caseable { case(text, Case::Upper) }
238	
239	// ② 影子类型：零变体 enum，仅作类型级句柄
240	#[doc(hidden)]
241	#[expect(non_camel_case_types)]
242	pub enum upper {}
243	
244	// ③ NativeFunc 实现：静态 NativeFuncData
245	impl NativeFunc for upper {
246	    fn data() -> &'static NativeFuncData {
247	        static DATA: NativeFuncData = NativeFuncData {
248	            function: NativeFuncPtr(&|engine, context, args| {
249	                let __typst_func = upper;
250	                let mut text: Caseable = args.expect("text")?;  // 参数解析
251	                args.take().finish()?;                          // 多余参数报错
252	                let output = __typst_func(text);
253	                IntoResult::into_result(output, args.span)      // 错误附上调用点
254	            }),
255	            name: "upper",
256	            title: "Uppercase",
257	            since: Some(Since::Forever),
258	            docs: "Converts a string or content to uppercase.\n...",
259	            def_site: Some(DefSite { path: file!(), key: "upper" }),
260	            keywords: &[],
261	            contextual: false,
262	            scope: LazyLock::new(&|| Scope::new()),
263	            params: LazyLock::new(&|| vec![NativeParamInfo {
264	                name: "text",
265	                docs: "The text to convert to uppercase.",
266	                def_site: Some(DefSite { path: file!(), key: "upper::text" }),
267	                input: <Caseable as Reflect>::input(),
268	                default: None,
269	                positional: true, named: false,
270	                variadic: false, required: true, settable: false,
271	            }]),
272	            returns: LazyLock::new(&|| <Caseable as Reflect>::output()),
273	        };
274	        &DATA
275	    }
276	}
277	```
278	
279	五行声明换来近四十行展开体——这就是「声明式库开发」的含义：**样板即生成物**。

324	#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案
325	
326	**练习 1**：如果给 `upper` 加一个 `#[named] #[default(0)] repeat: i64` 参数，展开后的解析代码是什么？
327	
328	**答案**：`let mut repeat: i64 = args.named("repeat")?.unwrap_or_else(|| 0);`——`#[named]` 走 `args.named`，`#[default]` 在 `None` 时兜底，对应 [crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs:462-474](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L462-L474) 的两个分支组合。
329	
330	**练习 2**：为什么闭包末尾要 `IntoResult::into_result(output, args.span)`，而不是直接 `Ok(output.into_value())`？
331	
332	**答案**：原生函数的返回类型有三种：`T`、`StrResult<T>`（错误无 span）与 `SourceResult<T>`。`IntoResult` 为三者分别实现了统一的转换，`StrResult` 的错误在这一步被 `.at(span)` 附上函数调用点的 span，让用户看到准确的报错位置。trait 定义见 [crates/typst-library/src/foundations/cast.rs:210-241](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/foundations/cast.rs#L210-L241)。
333	
334	**练习 3**：`luma` 的三个参数全部标了 `#[external]`，为什么？
335	
336	**答案**：`luma` 的参数语义有互斥歧义（给颜色时不能再给亮度），无法用统一的机械解析表达，所以参数只进文档表（`create_param_info` 不过滤 external），实际解析由函数体内的 `args.find::<Color>()` / `args.expect("lightness component")` 手工完成（[crates/typst-library/src/visualize/color.rs:384-403](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/visualize/color.rs#L384-L403)），因此它的签名里有特供参数 `args: &mut Args` 且宏不注入 `finish` 兜底。

338	### 4.3 `#[elem]` 展开产物：字段存储、`Construct`/`Set` 与能力 vtable
339	
340	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
341	
342	`#[elem]` 面向的是 [u3-l4](u3-l4-content-and-elements.md) 讲过的元素系统：一个元素 = 一个结构体 + 一组可从 Typst 脚本设置的字段 + 一份类型元数据。宏从结构体声明生成**六类产物**：
343	
344	1. **改写后的结构体**：字段按种类替换存储类型（见下表）；
345	2. **固有 impl**：`new()`（只收 required 字段）+ 每个可选字段的 builder 式 `with_x()` 方法 + 每个真实字段的 `Field<Self, i>` 常量（供样式链读写）；
346	3. **`NativeElement` 实现**：一个静态 vtable 常量 `ELEM`，携带名称、标题、文档、字段描述表和能力探针；
347	4. **逐字段 impl**：按字段种类实现 `RequiredField`/`SynthesizedField`/`SettableField`/`SettableProperty`/`ExternalField` 之一；
348	5. **`Construct` 实现**（除非手工提供）：从 `Args` 构造元素实例；
349	6. **`Set` 实现**（除非手工提供）：支持 `set` 规则。
350	
351	字段种类决定存储类型，这是理解元素结构的钥匙（生成逻辑在 `create_field`）：
352	
353	| 字段属性 | 结构体里的存储类型 | 语义 |
354	| --- | --- | --- |
355	| `#[required]` | 裸 `T` | 位置必选参数（如 heading 的 `body`） |
356	| `#[synthesized]` | `Option<T>` | 不能由用户设置，show 前由 `Synthesize` trait 填充 |
357	| 默认（settable） | `Settable<Self, i>` | 可选：实例上直设，或走样式链 |
358	| `#[ghost]` | 不进结构体 | 只存在于样式链（如 `TextElem` 的排版属性） |
359	| `#[external]` | 不进结构体 | 仅文档展示 |
360	| `#[internal]` | 照常进结构体 | 存在但对用户隐藏（不进 vtable 字段表） |
361	
362	一个重要澄清：`#[elem(Show, Count, Locatable, ..)]` 列表里的大多数名字**不是**让宏实现这些 trait——`Show`、`Synthesize`、`Count` 等能力的真正实现是库作者手写的（如 [crates/typst-library/src/model/heading.rs:249-365](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/model/heading.rs#L249-L365) 中对 `Packed<HeadingElem>` 的六个手工 impl）。宏对这份列表做三件事：挑选特殊生成物（`Construct`/`Set`/`Debug` derive 等）、生成能力探针闭包（运行时按 `TypeId` 动态查能力）、提取内省能力位（`Locatable`/`Unqueriable`/`Tagged`）。
363	
364	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
365	
366	```text
367	#[elem] 展开流程
368	  parse：解析元属性（name/title/since/keywords + 能力列表）
369	         逐字段解析属性 → Field { positional, required, variadic,
370	                                   fold, internal, external, ghost,
371	                                   synthesized, parse, default }
372	         校验组合合法性（required 不能又 synthesized/default/fold…）
373	         internal 字段排序沉底，编号 i 作为类型级索引
374	  create：
375	    ├─ create_struct         结构体（字段类型替换）
376	    ├─ create_inherent_impl  new + with_x + Field 常量
377	    ├─ create_native_elem_impl  ELEM vtable 常量
378	    ├─ create_field_impl × N    逐字段 trait + 元数据
379	    ├─ create_construct_impl    args → Self{..}（可被手工 Construct 覆盖）
380	    ├─ create_set_impl          args → Styles（可被手工 Set 覆盖）
381	    └─ create_mathy_impl        数学模式标记（可选）
382	    全部包进 const _: () = { .. } 匿名作用域，避免泄漏局部定义
383	```
384	
385	`Construct` 的字段解析器与 `#[func]` 的参数解析器几乎同构，映射表在 `create_field_parser`：variadic→`args.all`、required→`args.expect`、位置可选→`args.find`、命名→`args.named`（[crates/typst-macros/src/elem.rs:637-654](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/elem.rs#L637-L654)）。`#[parse({ .. })]` 属性可整块替换默认解析逻辑。

420	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
421	
422	**练习 1**：为什么 `#[ghost]` 字段不能出现在结构体里却仍要写在声明中？
423	
424	**答案**：ghost 字段（如 `TextElem` 的排版属性）只需要样式链存取通道，不需要实例存储。宏把它排除在 `struct_fields()` 之外（不进结构体、无 `with_` 方法），但保留 `Field<Self, i>` 常量与 `SettableProperty` impl 供 `styles.set/get` 使用。若元素有公开 ghost 字段，则禁止自动生成 `Construct`，校验见 [crates/typst-macros/src/elem.rs:176-183](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/elem.rs#L176-L183)。
425	
426	**练习 2**：`#[elem]` 元属性列表里的 `Construct` 和 `Set` 与其他能力名有什么不同？
427	
428	**答案**：它们是「负向开关」——写在列表里表示「我要手写实现，宏别自动生成」。`create()` 中 `element.cannot("Construct").then(|| create_construct_impl(element))`：只有**未**列出时才生成，见 [crates/typst-macros/src/elem.rs:258-260](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/elem.rs#L258-L260)。而 `Show`、`Count` 等列出了才具备，且实现由库作者手写。
429	
430	**练习 3**：字段在结构体里的顺序为何会被宏重排？
431	
432	**答案**：`parse` 阶段按 `internal` 排序，内部字段沉底，然后统一编号 `i`（[crates/typst-macros/src/elem.rs:170-174](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/elem.rs#L170-L174)）。编号以类型参数形式进入 `Settable<Self, i>` 与 `Field<Self, i>`，是样式链中区分字段的类型级索引。
433	
434	### 4.4 文档与注册同步：一份声明、三处消费
435	
436	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
437	
438	声明式宏体系最深的价值不是省代码，而是**同步**：函数名、参数表、默认值、文档、版本号、关键字、源码位置，全部萃取自同一份 Rust 声明，因此运行时行为、IDE 补全与官方文档站永远一致——不存在「文档忘了更新」的第三处真相。
439	
440	三个消费端分别是：
441	
442	1. **运行时注册**：`#[func]` 生成影子类型，`define_func::<upper>()` 这样的泛型调用把 `NativeFuncData` 装进全局作用域；
443	2. **IDE/反射**：`NativeParamInfo` 的每个布尔位与 `CastInfo` 直接服务补全与错误提示（[u3-l3](u3-l3-value-type-system.md) 提过 `Reflect` 对自动补全的重要性）；
444	3. **文档站**：`docs` crate 的 reflect 模块在运行时遍历标准库，把 `NativeFuncData` 翻译成文档页面数据。
445	
446	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
447	
448	doc 注释的旅程：
449	
450	```text
451	/// Converts a string ...
452	#[func]
453	pub fn upper(/// The text ... text: Caseable) ..
454	        │
455	        ▼ documentation()：syn 属性里抽出 #[doc = "..."] 字符串
456	        ▼ oneliner()：取首段首行作为摘要
457	   NativeFuncData { docs, params: [NativeParamInfo { docs, .. }] }
458	        │
459	        ├──（注册）text/mod.rs: define_func::<upper>() → 全局作用域 → 编译器可用
460	        └──（文档）docs/src/reflect.rs: describe_func(func)
461	                     → dict! { name, title, docs, params: [...], returns, ... }
462	                     → docs/components/reflect.typ 渲染成页面
463	```
464	
465	配套信息走同一条管道：`since` 版本号（解析为 `Since::Forever`/`Version`/`Unreleased` 三态，见 [crates/typst-macros/src/util.rs:349-374](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/util.rs#L349-L374)）、`keywords` 搜索别名、`DefSite { path: file!(), key }` 源码定位。
466	
467	命名也有自动同步规则：未指定 `name` 时取标识符的 kebab-case（`HeadingElem` 去掉 `Elem` 后缀变 `heading`），未指定 `title` 时取 title case；如果显式写出的名字和默认值相同，宏直接报错「name was specified unnecessarily」——逼你删掉冗余声明，见 [crates/typst-macros/src/util.rs:196-220](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/util.rs#L196-L220)。
468	
469	#### 4.4.3 源码精读
470	
471	**萃取**。`documentation()` 遍历条目的 syn 属性，收集所有 `#[doc = "..."]` 并去掉每行 leading 空格：[crates/typst-macros/src/util.rs:41-56](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/util.rs#L41-L56)——doc 注释在 syn 眼里就是普通属性，宏只是把编译器丢弃的信息捡了回来。
472	
473	**注册**。`#[func]` 生成的影子类型让注册调用变得极其简洁——`upper` 既指函数又指类型，`define_func::<upper>()` 里的 `upper` 解析到影子 enum，靠 `NativeFunc::data()` 拿到元数据：[crates/typst-library/src/text/mod.rs:69-70](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/text/mod.rs#L69-L70) 中两行完成 `lower`/`upper` 注册。foundations 模块的 `define` 函数里成片的 `global.define_type::<..>()`/`define_func::<..>()` 是整个标准库的装配现场：[crates/typst-library/src/foundations/mod.rs:90-118](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/foundations/mod.rs#L90-L118)。
474	
475	**作用域内函数的接线**。`#[scope]` 标注 `impl Color` 块时，`handle_fn` 检测到成员函数上的 `#[func]`，自动改写为 `#[func(.., parent = Color)]` 并发出 `scope.define_func_with_data(Color::luma_data())`：[crates/typst-macros/src/scope.rs:249-270](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/scope.rs#L249-L270)。`#[scope]` 最终生成 `NativeScope::scope()`，函数体就是一串 `scope.define/define_func/define_type/define_elem` 语句：[crates/typst-macros/src/scope.rs:120-137](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/scope.rs#L120-L137)。`Color` 的声明展示了 `#[ty(scope, cast)]` + `#[scope]` 的组合：[crates/typst-library/src/visualize/color.rs:175-185](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/visualize/color.rs#L175-L185)，`#[constant]` 常量（BLACK/WHITE…）与 `luma` 等构造函数都挂在这个作用域里。`#[func(constructor)]` 变体会被登记进 `NativeScope::constructor()` 而非作用域表，同时函数名改用父类型的 `NAME`（[crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs:331-335](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L331-L335)）。
476	
477	**文档站**。`docs/src/reflect.rs` 自己就用 `#[func]` 暴露了 `binding` 和 `describe` 两个查询函数（[L43-77](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/docs/src/reflect.rs#L43-L77)）——文档站的 typst 脚本通过它们反查标准库。`describe_func` 把 `Func` 的全部元数据（name/title/since/docs/def_site/keywords/scope）连同 `func.params()` 逐项搬进字典：[docs/src/reflect.rs:80-100](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/docs/src/reflect.rs#L80-L100)；`describe_param` 输出参数的六个布尔位、`CastInfo` 描述与默认值（默认值是 `fn() -> Value` 闭包，现场调用取值，[L103-122](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/docs/src/reflect.rs#L103-L122)）。你在 [typst.app/docs](https://typst.app/docs) 上看到的每个参数表、每个「默认值」示例，源头都是宏填进去的 `NativeParamInfo`。
478	
479	**cast 侧的同构**。`cast!` 宏为类型生成 `Reflect`/`IntoValue`/`FromValue` 时，同样把每个 match 臂的 doc 注释变成 `CastInfo::Value(值, 文档)`——错误消息「expected X, found Y」里的候选列表就是这么来的：[crates/typst-macros/src/cast.rs:242-271](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/cast.rs#L242-L271)。`Caseable` 的 `cast!`（[crates/typst-library/src/text/case.rs:50-58](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/text/case.rs#L50-L58)）声明「str 或 content 皆可」，于是 `upper` 参数表里的 `input` 自动是「string 或 content」，文档站与错误消息同步展示这一信息——无需任何人手写第二遍。
480	
481	#### 4.4.4 代码实践
482	
483	**实践目标**：验证「改一处 doc 注释，三处数据同时变」。
484	
485	**操作步骤**：
486	
487	1. 临时修改 [crates/typst-library/src/text/case.rs:30](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/text/case.rs#L30) 的参数 doc 注释（如把 `The text to convert to uppercase.` 改为 `PRACTICE: the text.`）；
488	2. 重跑 4.2.4 方式 A 的测试，观察 `param docs:` 输出变化；
489	3. 在 `tests/suite/` 下建一个临时 `.typ` 文件，内容 `#test(1, 1)` 之类即可，重点是在另一行写 `#upper()` 触发缺参错误，用 `cargo run -p typst-cli -- compile 临时.typ` 观察报错是否引用新注释（缺参报错来自 `args.expect`，其中参数名 `text` 就出自宏生成的参数表）；
490	4. 完成后还原 case.rs，删除临时文件。
491	
492	**需要观察的现象**：方式 A 的输出携带新注释；CLI 的缺参错误消息包含参数名 `text`（消息形如 `missing argument: text`，具体措辞待本地验证）。
493	
494	**预期结果**：确认 doc 注释与参数名这两个信息只存在于声明处，其余全部是衍生数据——改一处即全局生效。
495	
496	#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案
497	
498	**练习 1**：文档站上函数页的「Parameters」表格数据从哪里来？追一条完整链路。
499	
500	**答案**：参数 doc 注释 → `#[func]` 的 `create_param_info` 塞进 `NativeParamInfo.docs`（[crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs:442-455](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L442-L455)）→ `Func::params()` 运行时读出 → `describe_func`/`describe_param`（[docs/src/reflect.rs:90-122](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/docs/src/reflect.rs#L90-L122)）转成字典 → 文档站 typst 模板渲染成表格。
501	
502	**练习 2**：`#[func(title = "Uppercase")]` 不写会怎样？写了 `"Upper"` 又会怎样？
503	
504	**答案**：不写则默认 title case 得到 `Uppercase`（kebab 名 `upper` 转 title case）；写 `"Upper"` 就用自定义值。但如果显式写的值恰好等于默认值（如再写 `"Uppercase"`），编译直接失败——`determine_name_and_title` 的防冗余校验，见 [crates/typst-macros/src/util.rs:211-217](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/util.rs#L211-L217)。
505	
506	## 5. 综合实践
507	
508	**任务：给 `#[func]` 体系写一份「展开对照报告」**。
509	
510	以 `upper` 为对象，从三个角度采集数据并互相印证：
511	
512	1. **声明侧**：抄录 [crates/typst-library/src/text/case.rs:28-34](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/text/case.rs#L28-L34) 的五行声明（含属性与 doc 注释）。
513	2. **静态展开侧**：`cargo +nightly expand -p typst-library text::case`（或依据 4.2.3 的推导），截取 `upper` 的三件套：清洗后的 fn、影子 enum、`NativeFuncData` 字面量。逐项核对：`name` 从哪来、`title` 为何是 `"Uppercase"`、`since` 为何是 `Forever`、参数解析为什么选中 `args.expect("text")`、`finish` 兜底为什么存在。
514	3. **运行时反射侧**：运行 4.2.4 方式 A 的测试，把打印的参数表与展开侧的 `NativeParamInfo` 字面量对照；再故意在 typst 脚本里写 `#upper(1, 2)`，用 CLI 编译观察多余参数报错——它正是闭包第三段 `args.take().finish()?` 的产物。
515	
516	最后用一张表总结「错误处理样板」：缺参（`expect` 的 `missing argument`）、类型不符（`FromValue` 经 `Caseable` 的 cast 臂报 `expected string or content`）、多余参数（`finish`）、调用点定位（`into_result(.., args.span)`）各自由宏生成的哪一行负责。
517	
518	产出：一份 Markdown 报告，包含三侧数据与总结表。全部命令对仓库无持久修改（临时测试文件与脚本用后即删）。
519	
520	## 6. 本讲小结
521	
522	- `typst-macros` 提供七个宏：`#[func]`、`#[ty]`、`#[elem]`、`#[scope]`、`cast!`、`#[derive(Cast)]`、`#[time]`，全部经 `typst-library` 的门户模块重导出，只依赖 `syn`/`quote`/`heck`/`proc-macro2`。
523	- `#[func]` 为自由函数生成三件套：清洗后的原函数、同名零变体影子 enum、静态 `NativeFuncData`；作用域内函数则生成 `{name}_data()`。核心是四段式参数解析闭包：绑定 → 逐参解析 → `finish` 兜底 → `into_result` 附 span。
524	- 参数属性到 `Args` 消费方法有固定映射：`#[variadic]`→`all`、`#[named]`→`named`、带默认值的位置参数→`eat`、普通位置参数→`expect`；`engine`/`context`/`args`/`span` 四个特供参数按名字识别、不进参数表。
525	- `#[elem]` 生成六类产物；字段种类（required/synthesized/settable/ghost/external/internal）决定存储类型与逐字段 trait；能力列表大多只进动态 vtable 探针，真正的 `Show`/`Synthesize` 等仍由库作者手写；`Construct`/`Set` 写在列表里表示要手写。
526	- 同步机制的实质：doc 注释、`since`、`keywords`、命名、`DefSite` 全部萃取自唯一声明，经 `NativeFuncData`/`ContentVtable` 分别供给运行时注册、IDE 元数据与 `docs/src/reflect.rs` 文档站——一份声明、三处消费，永不漂移。
527	
528	## 7. 下一步学习建议
529	
530	本讲之后，你对「标准库如何被制造」已有完整认知，建议：
531	
532	1. **[u5-l6 语言工具](u5-l6-ide-tooling.md)**：看 `typst-ide` 如何消费本讲生成的 `NativeParamInfo`/`CastInfo` 做自动补全与签名提示——元数据的第二个消费者。
533	2. **通读 [crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs) 的宏文档注释**：它是贡献新内置函数/元素的官方指南，本讲未覆盖的边角（`#[scope(ext)]`、`#[defs]`、`#[parse]` 的写法细节）都在其中。
534	3. **动手试写**：仿照 `case.rs` 的模式，在本地分支给某个类型加一个最小的 `#[func]` 方法（如给 `Version` 加一个格式化函数），跑通 `cargo build` 后用 `cargo expand` 检查自己的展开，是检验本讲掌握程度的最快方式（改完记得还原）。
535	4. **回看 [u3-l5](u3-l5-func-and-args.md)**：此时再读 `Args::expect`/`finish` 的实现，你会认出其中每个分支正是宏生成代码的对接点。
536

# 宏的魔法：typst-macros 与声明式库开发

## 1. 本讲目标

Typst 标准库里有 600 多个内置函数、100 多个元素，但它们在 Rust 侧的声明大多只有寥寥数行。这背后的功臣是 `typst-macros` 这个过程宏 crate：你在 [u3-l5](u3-l5-func-and-args.md) 已经学过 `Func`、`Args` 与 cast 体系的**运行时**机制，本讲把镜头拉到**编译期**，看这些运行时结构是如何被自动生成出来的。

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 说出 `typst-macros` 导出的全部宏（`func`、`ty`、`elem`、`scope`、`cast!`、`derive(Cast)`、`time`）各自的职责与输入输出。
2. 手工推导一个 `#[func]` 函数（如 `upper`）的完整展开产物：清洗后的原函数、影子类型、`NativeFuncData` 常量与参数解析闭包。
3. 解释 `#[elem]` 如何从结构体声明生成字段存储、`Construct`/`Set` 实现与能力 vtable。
4. 用 `cargo expand`（或运行时反射测试）亲眼验证宏展开结果。
5. 讲清楚「一份声明、三处消费」的同步机制：同一份 Rust 声明同时驱动运行时注册、IDE 元数据与官方文档站。

## 2. 前置知识

**过程宏（procedural macro）**是 Rust 中「接收 token 流、返回 token 流」的编译期代码生成器。它分三种，本讲全都用到：

- **属性宏**：`#[func]`、`#[elem]`、`#[ty]`、`#[scope]`、`#[time]`——贴在条目上，改写这个条目；
- **函数式宏**：`cast! { .. }`——像函数调用一样接收 token 块；
- **派生宏**：`#[derive(Cast)]`——为枚举自动实现 trait。

写过程宏的标配三件套是 `syn`（把 token 解析成语法树）、`quote`（把语法树拼回 token）和 `proc-macro2`/`heck`（基础设施与命名风格转换）。`typst-macros` 的 `Cargo.toml` 里依赖恰好只有这四个，且 `[lib] proc-macro = true`——这是一个纯粹的编译期 crate，不含任何运行时代码。

一个关键的语言知识点（宏文档里也专门强调了）：**Rust 中函数和类型住在两个独立的命名空间**。所以可以同时存在 `fn upper()` 和 `enum upper {}`，互不冲突——宏正是利用这一点，为每个函数生成一个同名的「影子类型」，作为携带元数据的类型级句柄。

还需要回忆 [u3-l5](u3-l5-func-and-args.md) 的两个结论：`Args` 是消费式协议（`expect`/`named`/`eat`/`find`/`all` 各取所需、`finish` 兜底报错）；cast 体系由 `Reflect`（描述类型）、`IntoValue`（Rust→Typst）、`FromValue`（Typst→Rust）三个 trait 构成。本讲你会看到消费这些协议的样板代码正是宏生成的。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs` | 过程宏 crate 入口，声明全部 7 个宏及其完整使用文档 |
| `crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs` | `#[func]` 的解析与代码生成（本讲主角） |
| `crates/typst-macros/src/elem.rs` | `#[elem]` 的解析与代码生成 |
| `crates/typst-macros/src/cast.rs` | `cast!` 函数式宏与 `derive(Cast)` 的实现 |
| `crates/typst-macros/src/scope.rs` | `#[scope]`：把 impl 块变成 `NativeScope` 实现 |
| `crates/typst-macros/src/time.rs` | `#[time]`：向函数体注入计时作用域 |
| `crates/typst-macros/src/util.rs` | 共享工具：doc 注释抽取、命名推导、`Since` 解析 |
| `crates/typst-library/src/foundations/func.rs` | 消费端：`NativeFunc`、`NativeFuncData`、`NativeParamInfo` |
| `crates/typst-library/src/foundations/cast.rs` | 消费端：`Reflect`/`IntoValue`/`FromValue`/`IntoResult` trait 契约 |
| `crates/typst-library/src/text/case.rs` | 样本：`upper`/`lower` 函数与 `cast!`、`derive(Cast)` 实战 |
| `crates/typst-library/src/model/heading.rs` | 样本：`HeadingElem` 的真实声明 |
| `docs/src/reflect.rs` | 文档站反射：消费 `NativeFuncData` 生成文档页面 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 过程宏清单：七个宏与一条重导出链

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`typst-macros` 是一个独立的 proc-macro crate，它把「定义一个 Typst 可见实体」这件事**声明式化**：你只写一个普通 Rust 函数/结构体/枚举，加上属性宏和 doc 注释，宏负责生成注册、参数解析、元数据等全部样板。

整条流水线上每个宏对应一种「Typst 世界里的东西」：

| 宏 | 种类 | 贴在哪 | 生成的核心产物 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `#[func]` | 属性宏 | `fn` | 影子类型 + `NativeFunc` 实现（含 `NativeFuncData`） |
| `#[ty]` | 属性宏 | 类型 | `NativeType` 实现（类型名、作用域） |
| `#[elem]` | 属性宏 | 结构体 | `NativeElement` 实现 + 字段体系 + `Construct`/`Set` |
| `#[scope]` | 属性宏 | `impl` 块 | `NativeScope` 实现（方法/常量/子类型的注册表） |
| `cast!` | 函数式宏 | 类型声明处 | `Reflect` + `IntoValue` + `FromValue` 三件套 |
| `#[derive(Cast)]` | 派生宏 | 枚举 | 委托给 `cast!` 的字符串枚举转换 |
| `#[time]` | 属性宏 | `fn` | 函数体首行插入 `TimingScope`（性能计时） |

一个容易被忽略的架构细节：这些宏**不直接被库代码引用**，而是先由 `typst-library` 的「门户模块」重导出，库内部统一从 `crate::foundations` 导入：

- `func` 宏从 [crates/typst-library/src/foundations/func.rs:2](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/foundations/func.rs#L2) 重导出；
- `cast!` 与 `Cast` 派生从 [crates/typst-library/src/foundations/cast.rs:3](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/foundations/cast.rs#L3) 重导出；
- `elem` 宏从 [crates/typst-library/src/foundations/content/mod.rs:12](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/foundations/content/mod.rs#L12) 重导出；
- `scope` 与 `ty` 从 [crates/typst-library/src/foundations/mod.rs:71](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/foundations/mod.rs#L71) 重导出。

这样 `case.rs` 里只需一行 `use crate::foundations::{Cast, Content, Str, cast, func};` 就集齐了全部宏（见 [crates/typst-library/src/text/case.rs:1](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/text/case.rs#L1)），使用者的导入面保持最小。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

proc-macro crate 的生命周期非常简单：

```text
cargo 编译 typst-library
  → 遇到 #[func] 等属性
  → 先编译 typst-macros（proc-macro = true 的动态库）
  → 对每个被标注条目，调用对应宏函数：(属性参数 token 流, 条目 token 流) → 新 token 流
  → 用返回的 token 流替换原条目，继续编译
```

每个属性宏入口的模式完全一致（以 `func` 为例）：

1. `syn::parse_macro_input!` 把条目解析成 `syn::ItemFn`；
2. 调用同名子模块的实现函数（`func::func`）；
3. 出错时 `err.to_compile_error()` 把编译错误注入 token 流，成功则返回生成代码。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

`lib.rs` 顶部声明了全部子模块，注意 `#[macro_use] mod util;` 让工具函数（如 `bail!`）在子模块中可用：[crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs:5-12](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs#L5-L12)。

七个宏的入口分别是：

- `#[func]`：[crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs:103-109](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs#L103-L109)——解析 `ItemFn` 后交给 `func::func`。它上方的文档注释（[L17-102](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs#L17-L102)）是全宏体系最详尽的使用手册，列出了 `scope`/`contextual`/`name`/`title`/`keywords`/`constructor` 六个属性和 `#[named]`/`#[default]`/`#[variadic]`/`#[external]` 四个参数属性，以及 `engine`/`context`/`args`/`span` 四个「运行时特供参数」。
- `#[ty]`：[crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs:136-142](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs#L136-L142)，接收任意 `syn::Item`（结构体或枚举）。
- `#[elem]`：[crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs:212-218](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs#L212-L218)，只接受 `syn::ItemStruct`。
- `#[scope]`：[crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs:261-267](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs#L261-L267)。
- `cast!`：[crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs:297-302](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs#L297-L302)，注意它是 `#[proc_macro]`（函数式），只接收一段 token 流。
- `#[derive(Cast)]`：[crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs:323-329](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs#L323-L329)。
- `#[time]`：[crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs:363-369](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs#L363-L369)。

`#[time]` 的实现最能体现「属性宏=函数体改写」的本质：它只是在函数体最前面插一句 `let __scope = TimingScope::new(name);`，靠 RAII 在作用域结束时记录耗时——[crates/typst-macros/src/time.rs:29-44](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/time.rs#L29-L44)。这正是 [u4-l1](u4-l1-compile-pipeline-overview.md) 里 `--timings` 计时功能的代码注入点。

依赖清单印证了「纯编译期 crate」的判断——只有 `heck`、`proc-macro2`、`quote`、`syn` 四个依赖：[crates/typst-macros/Cargo.toml:15-22](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/Cargo.toml#L15-L22)。

**实践目标**：不运行任何东西，先建立「宏使用密度」的定量直觉。

**操作步骤**：

1. 在仓库根目录执行（只读命令）：

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `typst-macros` 能生成一个和函数同名的 `enum` 而不报「重复定义」？

**答案**：Rust 有三个命名空间（类型、值、宏），函数 `fn upper` 位于值命名空间，`enum upper` 位于类型命名空间，二者不冲突。宏文档在 [crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs:17-27](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs#L17-L27) 明确说明了这一设计。

**练习 2**：`#[time]` 宏为什么能无侵入地计时？

**答案**：它在函数体首行插入 `TimingScope` 绑定，函数返回时该值析构，析构函数记录本次调用的结束时间与耗时（RAII 模式），见 [crates/typst-macros/src/time.rs:36-41](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/time.rs#L36-L41)。

### 4.2 `#[func]` 展开产物：影子类型、`NativeFuncData` 与参数解析闭包

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`#[func]` 解决的问题是：把一个「普通 Rust 函数」变成「Typst 世界的一等函数」。回顾 [u3-l5](u3-l5-func-and-args.md)：运行时调用一个原生函数时，实际执行的是签名 `dyn Fn(&mut Engine, Tracked<Context>, &mut Args) -> SourceResult<Value>` 的函数指针，并且需要一份描述参数表的 `NativeFuncData` 元数据。手写这两样东西（从 `Args` 里逐个取参数、转换类型、报告错误、登记参数文档）极其繁琐且容易漏——`#[func]` 把这一切从函数签名和 doc 注释**自动推导**出来。

对每个被标注的自由函数，宏生成**三件套**：

1. **清洗后的原函数**（剥掉自定义属性、加上单行 doc）；
2. **影子类型**：一个零变体 `enum`，名字与函数相同，纯类型级句柄；
3. **`NativeFunc` 实现**：`data()` 返回一个静态初始化的 `NativeFuncData`，内含函数指针、名称、文档、参数表。

而当函数位于 `#[scope]` 标注的 impl 块内时，无法在 impl 块里再定义类型，宏改为一对一生成 `{name}_data()` 自由函数（由 `#[scope]` 负责接线），这在 [crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs:23-27](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/lib.rs#L23-L27) 有说明。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

`#[func]` 的展开分两个阶段，伪代码如下：

```text
阶段一：解析（func::parse）
  解析 #[func(..)] 元属性 → Meta { scope, contextual, name, title, since, keywords, constructor, parent }
  遍历函数签名参数：
    名为 engine/context/args/span 的参数 → 记入 SpecialParams（不进参数表）
    &self/&mut self        → SpecialParams.self_（需显式 parent 类型）
    其余参数 → Param {
      named ← #[named]       （命名可选参数）
      variadic ← #[variadic] （变长参数，类型须为 Vec<_>）
      external ← #[external] （仅进文档，不生成解析代码）
      default ← #[default] 或 #[default(expr)]
    }
  从 doc 注释抽取文档串

阶段二：生成（func::create）
  1) rewrite_fn_item：剥掉参数上的全部属性、剥掉函数属性 → 干净的 fn
  2) create_func_ty：生成零变体影子 enum（仅自由函数）
  3) create_func_data：拼出 NativeFuncData 字面量
     ├─ create_wrapper_closure：参数解析闭包（真正的调用入口）
     ├─ create_param_info × N：每个参数一条 NativeParamInfo
     └─ returns: <返回类型 as Reflect>::output()
  4) 输出：清洗后的 fn + 影子 enum + impl NativeFunc
```

其中参数解析闭包是精华，它固定为四段结构（对应 `create_wrapper_closure`）：

```text
|engine, context, args| {
    let __typst_func = 原函数;            // ① 绑定
    ② 逐参数解析（create_param_parser）
    ③ args.take().finish()?;              // 兜底：报告多余参数（仅当没有手动 args 参数）
    ④ let output = __typst_func(..); IntoResult::into_result(output, args.span)
}
```

每个参数按属性选择不同的 `Args` 消费方法，这个映射表是宏的核心逻辑（[crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs:459-477](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L459-L477)）：

| 参数声明 | 生成的解析代码 | Args 方法 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `#[variadic] values: Vec<T>` | `let mut values: Vec<T> = args.all()?;` | `all`（吃光所有剩余位置参数） |
| `#[named] x: T` | `let mut x: T = args.named("x")?.unwrap_or_else(默认值);` | `named` |
| 位置参数带 `#[default]` | `let mut x: T = args.eat()?.unwrap_or_else(默认值);` | `eat`（取一个，没有则 None） |
| 普通位置参数 | `let mut x: T = args.expect("x")?;` | `expect`（必须有，否则报错） |

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

**宏侧**。解析入口在 [crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs:14-17](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L14-L17)；`Func` 结构体（[L20-51](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L20-L51)）汇集了名字、文档、特殊参数与参数表。

参数识别的关键代码：四个运行时特供参数按名字硬匹配，其余才进参数表——[crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs:222-246](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L222-L246)。这段还做了一件事：参数的 Typst 名取 Rust 标识符的 kebab-case（`ident.to_string().to_kebab_case()`），所以 `lightness` 无需任何标注就叫 `lightness`。

总装函数 `create` 决定输出三件套的形态——自由函数走「影子 enum + `impl NativeFunc`」，作用域内函数走 `{name}_data()`：[crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs:252-290](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L252-L290)。

`create_func_data` 拼出 `NativeFuncData` 字面量，注意三个 `LazyLock`：作用域、参数表、返回值描述都是**惰性求值**的静态数据（首次访问才构造，编译期零成本）：[crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs:339-353](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L339-L353)。`def_site` 用 `file!()` 宏记录定义所在的源文件路径，为 IDE 跳转和文档「查看源码」提供锚点（[L346](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L346)）。

四段式闭包的生成在 [crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs:371-419](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L371-L419)：`handlers` 跳过 `#[external]` 参数（[L373-384](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L373-L384)）；`finish` 只在没有手动 `args` 参数时插入（[L387](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L387)）；调用点把特供参数按固定顺序 `self, engine, context, args, span` 排列转发（[L390-405](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L390-L405)）；最后 `IntoResult::into_result` 统一把返回值（`T`/`StrResult<T>`/`SourceResult<T>`）包装成 `SourceResult<Value>` 并附加调用点 span（[L410-418](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L410-L418)）。

`NativeParamInfo` 的生成在 [crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs:422-456](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L422-L456)，其中 `positional`、`required` 等布尔位全部由参数属性推导，`input` 字段调用 `<T as Reflect>::input()` 获得该参数可接受类型的描述——**宏只组装结构，类型信息来自 cast 体系**，这就是 4.4 节同步机制的基石。

**库侧（消费端）**。`NativeFunc` trait 提供默认的 `func()` 并要求实现 `data()`：[crates/typst-library/src/foundations/func.rs:689-699](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/foundations/func.rs#L689-L699)。`NativeFuncData` 的字段与宏生成的字面量一一对应（[L701-726](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/foundations/func.rs#L701-L726)）；函数指针类型 `NativeFuncSignature` 正是闭包的签名（[L733-738](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/foundations/func.rs#L733-L738)）；`DynLazyLock` 是「以静态闭包初始化的 LazyLock」的类型别名，解释了宏里 `LazyLock::new(&|| ..)` 的写法（[L746-753](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/foundations/func.rs#L746-L753)）。

**样本：`upper`**。它的完整声明只有五行（[crates/typst-library/src/text/case.rs:28-34](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/text/case.rs#L28-L34)）：

```rust
#[func(title = "Uppercase", since = "forever")]
pub fn upper(
    /// The text to convert to uppercase.
    text: Caseable,
) -> Caseable {
    case(text, Case::Upper)
}
```

依据宏源码逐行推导（下节实践会验证），它展开为（**示例代码：手工推导的展开形态**）：

```rust
// ① 清洗后的原函数（doc 换成首行摘要）
#[doc = "Converts a string or content to uppercase."]
#[expect(dead_code)]
#[expect(rustdoc::broken_intra_doc_links)]
pub fn upper(text: Caseable) -> Caseable { case(text, Case::Upper) }

// ② 影子类型：零变体 enum，仅作类型级句柄
#[doc(hidden)]
#[expect(non_camel_case_types)]
pub enum upper {}

// ③ NativeFunc 实现：静态 NativeFuncData
impl NativeFunc for upper {
    fn data() -> &'static NativeFuncData {
        static DATA: NativeFuncData = NativeFuncData {
            function: NativeFuncPtr(&|engine, context, args| {
                let __typst_func = upper;
                let mut text: Caseable = args.expect("text")?;  // 参数解析
                args.take().finish()?;                          // 多余参数报错
                let output = __typst_func(text);
                IntoResult::into_result(output, args.span)      // 错误附上调用点
            }),
            name: "upper",
            title: "Uppercase",
            since: Some(Since::Forever),
            docs: "Converts a string or content to uppercase.\n...",
            def_site: Some(DefSite { path: file!(), key: "upper" }),
            keywords: &[],
            contextual: false,
            scope: LazyLock::new(&|| Scope::new()),
            params: LazyLock::new(&|| vec![NativeParamInfo {
                name: "text",
                docs: "The text to convert to uppercase.",
                def_site: Some(DefSite { path: file!(), key: "upper::text" }),
                input: <Caseable as Reflect>::input(),
                default: None,
                positional: true, named: false,
                variadic: false, required: true, settable: false,
            }]),
            returns: LazyLock::new(&|| <Caseable as Reflect>::output()),
        };
        &DATA
    }
}
```

五行声明换来近四十行展开体——这就是「声明式库开发」的含义：**样板即生成物**。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：如果给 `upper` 加一个 `#[named] #[default(0)] repeat: i64` 参数，展开后的解析代码是什么？

**答案**：`let mut repeat: i64 = args.named("repeat")?.unwrap_or_else(|| 0);`——`#[named]` 走 `args.named`，`#[default]` 在 `None` 时兜底，对应 [crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs:462-474](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/func.rs#L462-L474) 的两个分支组合。

**练习 2**：为什么闭包末尾要 `IntoResult::into_result(output, args.span)`，而不是直接 `Ok(output.into_value())`？

**答案**：原生函数的返回类型有三种：`T`、`StrResult<T>`（错误无 span）与 `SourceResult<T>`。`IntoResult` 为三者分别实现了统一的转换，`StrResult` 的错误在这一步被 `.at(span)` 附上函数调用点的 span，让用户看到准确的报错位置。trait 定义见 [crates/typst-library/src/foundations/cast.rs:210-241](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/foundations/cast.rs#L210-L241)。

**练习 3**：`luma` 的三个参数全部标了 `#[external]`，为什么？

**答案**：`luma` 的参数语义有互斥歧义（给颜色时不能再给亮度），无法用统一的机械解析表达，所以参数只进文档表（`create_param_info` 不过滤 external），实际解析由函数体内的 `args.find::<Color>()` / `args.expect("lightness component")` 手工完成（[crates/typst-library/src/visualize/color.rs:384-403](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/visualize/color.rs#L384-L403)），因此它的签名里有特供参数 `args: &mut Args` 且宏不注入 `finish` 兜底。

### 4.3 `#[elem]` 展开产物：字段存储、`Construct`/`Set` 与能力 vtable

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

`#[elem]` 面向的是 [u3-l4](u3-l4-content-and-elements.md) 讲过的元素系统：一个元素 = 一个结构体 + 一组可从 Typst 脚本设置的字段 + 一份类型元数据。宏从结构体声明生成**六类产物**：

1. **改写后的结构体**：字段按种类替换存储类型（见下表）；
2. **固有 impl**：`new()`（只收 required 字段）+ 每个可选字段的 builder 式 `with_x()` 方法 + 每个真实字段的 `Field<Self, i>` 常量（供样式链读写）；
3. **`NativeElement` 实现**：一个静态 vtable 常量 `ELEM`，携带名称、标题、文档、字段描述表和能力探针；
4. **逐字段 impl**：按字段种类实现 `RequiredField`/`SynthesizedField`/`SettableField`/`SettableProperty`/`ExternalField` 之一；
5. **`Construct` 实现**（除非手工提供）：从 `Args` 构造元素实例；
6. **`Set` 实现**（除非手工提供）：支持 `set` 规则。

字段种类决定存储类型，这是理解元素结构的钥匙（生成逻辑在 `create_field`）：

| 字段属性 | 结构体里的存储类型 | 语义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `#[required]` | 裸 `T` | 位置必选参数（如 heading 的 `body`） |
| `#[synthesized]` | `Option<T>` | 不能由用户设置，show 前由 `Synthesize` trait 填充 |
| 默认（settable） | `Settable<Self, i>` | 可选：实例上直设，或走样式链 |
| `#[ghost]` | 不进结构体 | 只存在于样式链（如 `TextElem` 的排版属性） |
| `#[external]` | 不进结构体 | 仅文档展示 |
| `#[internal]` | 照常进结构体 | 存在但对用户隐藏（不进 vtable 字段表） |

一个重要澄清：`#[elem(Show, Count, Locatable, ..)]` 列表里的大多数名字**不是**让宏实现这些 trait——`Show`、`Synthesize`、`Count` 等能力的真正实现是库作者手写的（如 [crates/typst-library/src/model/heading.rs:249-365](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-library/src/model/heading.rs#L249-L365) 中对 `Packed<HeadingElem>` 的六个手工 impl）。宏对这份列表做三件事：挑选特殊生成物（`Construct`/`Set`/`Debug` derive 等）、生成能力探针闭包（运行时按 `TypeId` 动态查能力）、提取内省能力位（`Locatable`/`Unqueriable`/`Tagged`）。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```text
#[elem] 展开流程
  parse：解析元属性（name/title/since/keywords + 能力列表）
         逐字段解析属性 → Field { positional, required, variadic,
                                   fold, internal, external, ghost,
                                   synthesized, parse, default }
         校验组合合法性（required 不能又 synthesized/default/fold…）
         internal 字段排序沉底，编号 i 作为类型级索引
  create：
    ├─ create_struct         结构体（字段类型替换）
    ├─ create_inherent_impl  new + with_x + Field 常量
    ├─ create_native_elem_impl  ELEM vtable 常量
    ├─ create_field_impl × N    逐字段 trait + 元数据
    ├─ create_construct_impl    args → Self{..}（可被手工 Construct 覆盖）
    ├─ create_set_impl          args → Styles（可被手工 Set 覆盖）
    └─ create_mathy_impl        数学模式标记（可选）
    全部包进 const _: () = { .. } 匿名作用域，避免泄漏局部定义
```

`Construct` 的字段解析器与 `#[func]` 的参数解析器几乎同构，映射表在 `create_field_parser`：variadic→`args.all`、required→`args.expect`、位置可选→`args.find`、命名→`args.named`（[crates/typst-macros/src/elem.rs:637-654](https://github.com/typst/typst/blob/84cca406aafe7f830ed3f37f1cc6f0c8b6b65a03/crates/typst-macros/src/elem.rs#L637-L654)）。`#[parse({ .. })]` 属性可整块替换默认解析逻辑。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读
